provenance.note: One fixed interior (roles.core), identified once at t=identify, shared across every method below -- only the actuator-selection policy differs.

no_control.label: No Control
no_control.subtitle: Natural dynamics, no intervention
no_control.why: No intervention applied; the flock continued its pre-existing dynamics and did not reach the target.

random_exterior.label: Random Exterior
random_exterior.subtitle: Generic external forcing (wrong pool)
random_exterior.why: Failed: actuators drawn from anywhere outside the core, not the true interaction shell -- most have no direct edge into the frozen core.

fiedler_boundary.label: Fiedler Boundary
fiedler_boundary.subtitle: Spectral separator, not the true interface
fiedler_boundary.why: Failed: only 15 controlled birds, with incomplete overlap with the true one-step interaction shell (B^D).

connected_patch.label: Connected Shell Patch
connected_patch.subtitle: Correct interface, concentrated support
connected_patch.why: Succeeded, but relied on a spatially concentrated patch -- V3 found this rule the weakest and most variable across flocks.

distributed_shell.label: Distributed Shell Sample
distributed_shell.subtitle: Correct interface, random distribution
distributed_shell.why: Failed on this particular random draw from the correct shell; see ensemble statistics for the typical outcome at this budget.

v2_conservative_shell.label: V2 Conservative Shell
v2_conservative_shell.subtitle: Large-budget policy (V2, frozen)
v2_conservative_shell.why: Succeeded: a large, conservative fraction of the true interaction shell gives high reliability at higher actuator cost.

sparse_interface_multicover.label: Sparse Interface Multicover
sparse_interface_multicover.subtitle: Our refined controller (V3)
sparse_interface_multicover.why: Succeeded: enough of the core received redundant (>=2 actuator) target-consistent support, using fewer actuators than the conservative V2 policy.

full_dynamical_shell.label: Full Dynamical Shell
full_dynamical_shell.subtitle: Maximal admissible interface control
full_dynamical_shell.why: Succeeded: strong redundant support across the entire interaction interface, at the highest actuator cost of any admissible method.

direct_core_diagnostic.label: Direct Core Forcing
direct_core_diagnostic.subtitle: Diagnostic only -- bypasses the interface
direct_core_diagnostic.why: Succeeded trivially: core birds are forced directly, bypassing the interface entirely -- inadmissible as a control method, shown only for diagnostic contrast.
